mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_meeting_summary (id, user_id, asr_session_id, summary_source, summary_target, key_points, action_items, decisions, keywords, subtitle_count, total_tokens, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{asrSessionId}, #{summarySource}, #{summaryTarget}, #{keyPoints}, #{actionItems}, #{decisions}, #{keywords}, #{subtitleCount}, #{totalTokens}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
